description: IRVE Mairie de Kerbach is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mairie de Kerbach. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
